_comment: ChainDrop / Shai-Hulud npm supply-chain compromise of tensorlake, the npm SDK for Tensorlake's AI agent sandbox infrastructure, reported by Socket on 2026-10-08. Malicious version 0.5.144 was published 2026-10-08T01:12:07Z and adds a preinstall hook (node lib/setup.mjs) that launches an obfuscated loader via Bun to run lib/Math_Symbol.js, a credential-stealing, self-propagating worm payload targeting npm, GitHub, AWS, HashiCorp Vault, Kubernetes, SSH, .env, wallet, and AI-tool (.claude, .cursor, .kiro, Windsurf, Zed) secrets, with an Ethereum-contract C2 resolver and a gh-token-monitor dead-man switch. The version was subsequently removed from npm: the packument retains its 2026-10-08T01:12:07.320Z publication timestamp but no longer exposes version metadata (dist-tag latest is 0.5.143). Corroborated by OSV MAL-2026-17650 and GHSA-rqxj-g25x-4v9v (both published 2026-10-08T02:54:39Z), which enumerate 0.5.144 as the affected version.
